full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white fashion photograph frames two young women from the chest up against a plain middle-gray studio background. Both wear dark rounded hats and high dark coats, creating a broad, joined near-black shape across the lower half. The woman on the left stands slightly farther back, her dark hair nearly disappearing under the brim; she turns her face toward the camera with a steady, unsmiling gaze. The woman on the right occupies more of the foreground. A short pale-blond bob curves outward beneath her hat, and she angles her head slightly toward the left while looking past the viewer. Their faces sit close together near the center but do not touch, and the hats almost meet across the upper edge. This tight pairing produces a graphic double silhouette: two large dark domes above, two pale ovals within, and a continuous black clothing base below. The background carries no furniture or props, only a smooth gray tonal field that separates the outer edges. Directional studio light from the upper left illuminates the faces cleanly, especially cheekbones, eyes, and lips. The brims cast shallow shadows over the upper eyes, and the dark coats retain little detail, emphasizing shape over textile. Fine grain and soft silver-gray transitions in skin and blond hair preserve a photographic surface; edges are sharp at the hat rims and eyelashes. The palette is entirely grayscale, with contrast concentrated between pale faces and nearly black wardrobe. The image feels cool, poised, and modern, its impact coming from close cropping, paired expressions, and precise tonal design rather than movement or setting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白时装照片在朴素中灰影棚背景前，从胸部以上框住两名年轻女子。两人都戴深色圆帽、穿高领深色外套，形成横跨下半部的宽大、连接起来的近黑体块。左侧女子稍靠后，深发几乎消失在帽檐下；她转脸朝向相机，目光稳定，不带笑。右侧女子占更多前景，一头浅金短波波发从帽下向外卷，头略向左偏，视线掠过观众。两张脸在中央附近靠近却不相触，两顶帽在上方边缘几乎碰到。这种紧密配对产生图形性的双重剪影：上方两个大深色圆顶，中间两个浅色椭圆，下方是连续黑色衣物底。背景没有家具或道具，只有平滑灰色明度域分开外轮廓。左上方定向影棚光干净地照亮两张脸，特别是颧骨、眼睛和嘴唇。帽檐在眼睛上部投下浅影，深色外套保留很少细节，强调形状而非纺织物。细颗粒与皮肤、金发里的柔银灰过渡保留摄影表面；帽缘和睫毛处边缘清楚。配色完全灰阶，对比集中在浅面孔与近黑衣装之间。图像冷静、从容且现代，冲击力来自近裁切、成对表情与精确明暗设计，而非运动或场所。
style_prompt_en: A crisp monochrome studio-photographic treatment builds the frame from paired near-black rounded masses, a continuous dark lower field, two small luminous midtone areas, and a plain middle-gray surround. The crop is tight, making neighboring forms nearly touch at the top while their outer silhouettes remain clearly separated from the background. Directional upper-side light creates clean highlights on smooth curved planes, a shallow shadow under each dark overhang, and soft silver transitions inside the light areas. Fine film grain is visible without softening the sharpest rims and tiny focal details. Textile-like regions are deliberately low-detail and almost black, allowing the graphic light-dark pattern to dominate. The composition is balanced but slightly staggered in depth, with one form set marginally forward and the other a little back. No props or setting interrupt the tonal structure. The effect is poised, cool, and editorial, relying on precise grayscale area relationships and close spatial proximity.
style_prompt_zh: 清晰的单色影棚摄影处理由一对近黑圆浑体块、一块连续深暗下部色域、两小片发亮中间调区域及朴素中灰围绕构成画框。裁切紧密，让相邻形体在上方几乎相触，同时外剪影仍与背景清楚分开。上侧定向光在平滑曲面上产生干净高光，在每处深色遮盖下投出浅影，并于浅色区域内部形成柔银色过渡。可见细胶片颗粒，却不柔化最锐利边缘和微小焦点细节。类织物区域有意减少细节，几乎黑色，让图形化明暗图案主导。构图平衡，但纵深轻微错列，一处形体稍前，另一处稍后。没有道具或场所打断明暗结构。效果从容、冷静而有编辑摄影感，依靠精确灰阶面积关系与近距离空间排列。
theme_en: Two women in dark hats and coats in a sharply lit monochrome fashion photograph
theme_zh: 黑白时装照片里，两名女子戴深色帽子、穿深色外套并肩站立
name: Terence Donovan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
